source_text: It has common traits of buzz-pollinated plants, including poricidal anthers and nectarless flowers. For every floral visitor, we recorded the behavior the individual used to extract pollen (buzzing or not buzzing).

Hand pollination experiments showed that S. obtusifolia is fully self-compatible but that it can set little seed in the absence of pollinators in both the native and invaded regions (Lopresti et al., unpublished).
